user_template:
Please answer each of the following Yes/No questions about your newborn's vaccination status:
(1) Has your newborn received BCG within the first 28 days of life?
(2) Has your newborn received at least one dose of oral Polio (OPV0) within the first 14 days of life?

Give your response in the following format: [Yes/No; Yes/No]

treatment.Reminder: Shortly after your delivery, a Community Health Volunteer (CHV) from your community visited you, explained the Ghana Early Vaccination Program, and obtained your written informed consent. The CHV had received training in community health promotion from the Ghana Health Service, plus additional standardised training from the program team for this work. You provided a phone number where you could be reached - your own phone, a shared household phone, or the phone of someone close to you who could pass messages along. The CHV congratulated you on the birth, explained that newborns should receive BCG within 28 days of life and the first dose of oral Polio (OPV0) within 14 days of life, and gave you tailored information about exactly when and where vaccination services for your community are available - the specific dates, times and locations of the next community-outreach visit and the schedule of the nearest fixed clinic. Over the following weeks, up to three further attempts were made to reach you with this information. If your newborn had not yet received both early vaccines, the CHV continued to follow up with you periodically through the first 28 days of newborn life, with additional reminders about the importance of timely vaccination and the schedule of available services. You could ask to stop being contacted at any time, at no cost to you.
